text: The author Ben Mears returns to his small hometown of Salem's Lot, Maine, to write about the Marsten House, the hilltop property he saw a ghost in as a boy. A newcomer named Straker has bought it, a large crate is delivered one night, and soon townspeople begin to disappear. The crate holds [an ancient vampire|threat|blood drinkers], and [the dead boy Ralphie Glick comes back for his brother|ending|victims become the evil], while Ben and young Mark Petrie arm themselves with [crosses, holy water and a stake|rules|faith and charms protect].
